summary.text: Erik Muckey is a Democratic state representative from South Dakota House District 15 who is running for South Dakota State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a sixth-generation South Dakotan and former CEO of the youth suicide prevention nonprofit Lost&Found.

paragraphs.text: Erik Muckey was born in Platte, South Dakota.

He earned a high school diploma from Corsica High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of South Dakota in 2014, and a graduate degree from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, in 2020, and his career experience includes working as a nonprofit consultant and executive director.

Muckey assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, and is assigned to the House Appropriations Committee and the House Retirement Laws Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he served on the Joint Committee on Appropriations as the sole caucusing Democrat and that he has prime-sponsored four bills into law.
He listed education funding, access to health care including mental health care, and affordability for working families as his key campaign messages.
